title: Orthogonality of distinct Walsh characters
statement:
Fix $n \in \bbn$, and let $S, T \subseteq [n]$ be two distinct subsets. Then the Walsh--Fourier characters $\chi_S$ and $\chi_T$ are orthogonal with respect to the uniform inner product on $\{0,1\}^n$:
\[
  \langle \chi_S, \chi_T \rangle = \frac{1}{2^n}\sum_{x \in \{0,1\}^n} \chi_S(x)\,\chi_T(x) = 0.
\]
hypotheses_covered: S and T are subsets of [n]
S and T are distinct (S ≠ T)
